ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: The visible ventral surface exhibits a high-contrast distribution with approximately 70-75% high-intensity (white/off-white) pixels and 25-30% low-intensity (black) pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity contiguous blobs occupy the central and medial regions of both lobes. Low-intensity black pigment is localized to the peduncle junction, the entire trailing edge perimeter, and the distal tips, with fine linear striations extending from the tips toward the center.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate interior angle of 55 degrees; the vertex is well-defined at the junction of the lobe boundaries.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The right lobe (viewer perspective) shows high-frequency, high-amplitude serrations with at least five distinct peaks. The left lobe (viewer perspective) shows a more irregular, jagged topography with significant pixel-level discontinuities.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Asymmetrical convex curves; the left lobe exhibits a steeper upward sweep toward the distal tip, while the right lobe displays a more elongated, horizontal convexity.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of three localized, circular high-intensity pixel clusters in the lower-medial quadrant of the right fluke lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct low-intensity linear streaks (rake-like marks) are visible on the left lobe, oriented diagonally from the leading edge towards the central notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant non-linear tissue loss or 'bite-shaped' excision visible on the distal trailing edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely pronounced, sharp serration pattern localized to the inner-medial section of the right lobe trailing edge.
